import pandas as pd

# Paths to source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_3/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_3/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_3/training_2.csv"

# Read source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source dataframes
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2], ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order and types:
# Target Schema: ['username': float, 'date': string, 'retweets': integer, 'favorites': integer,
# 'text': string, 'geo': string, 'mentions': string, 'hashtags': string, 'id': float, 'permalink': string]

# Convert 'username' to float (all NaN in sources, so will remain NaN)
df['username'] = pd.to_numeric(df['username'], errors='coerce')

# Convert 'date' to string (should already be string, but ensure)
df['date'] = df['date'].astype(str)

# Convert 'retweets' and 'favorites' to integer (fill NaN with 0 before conversion)
df['retweets'] = pd.to_numeric(df['retweets'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
df['favorites'] = pd.to_numeric(df['favorites'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# 'text', 'geo', 'mentions', 'hashtags', 'permalink' to string, fill NaN with empty string
for col in ['text', 'geo', 'mentions', 'hashtags', 'permalink']:
    df[col] = df[col].fillna("").astype(str)

# Convert 'id' to float
df['id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['id'], errors='coerce')

# Reorder columns to target schema order
target_columns = ['username', 'date', 'retweets', 'favorites', 'text', 'geo', 'mentions', 'hashtags', 'id', 'permalink']
df = df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_3/target_multisource.csv"
df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_3/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_3/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_3/training_2.csv", index_col=0)

# Convert 'id' columns to string to avoid float precision issues during join
source0['id'] = source0['id'].astype(str)
source1['id'] = source1['id'].astype(str)
source2['id'] = source2['id'].astype(str)

# Join source1 and source2 to source0 on 'id' (inner join)
df_join_01 = pd.merge(source0, source1, on='id', suffixes=('_0', '_1'), how='inner')
df_join_all = pd.merge(df_join_01, source2, on='id', suffixes=('', '_2'), how='inner')

# After join, select columns from source0 (base) and aggregate numerical columns from all sources
# The target schema is:
# ['username': float, 'date': string, 'retweets': integer, 'favorites': integer, 'text': string, 'geo': string, 'mentions': string, 'hashtags': string, 'id': float, 'permalink': string]

# For username and id, target examples show NaN and float type, so convert username to float (NaN) and id to float
# For id, convert back to float
df_join_all['username'] = pd.to_numeric(df_join_all['username_0'], errors='coerce')
df_join_all['date'] = df_join_all['date_0']
df_join_all['text'] = df_join_all['text_0']
df_join_all['geo'] = df_join_all['geo_0']
df_join_all['mentions'] = df_join_all['mentions_0']
df_join_all['hashtags'] = df_join_all['hashtags_0']
df_join_all['permalink'] = df_join_all['permalink_0']
df_join_all['id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_join_all['id'], errors='coerce')

# Sum retweets and favorites from all three sources
df_join_all['retweets'] = df_join_all['retweets_0'].fillna(0) + df_join_all['retweets_1'].fillna(0) + df_join_all['retweets']
df_join_all['favorites'] = df_join_all['favorites_0'].fillna(0) + df_join_all['favorites_1'].fillna(0) + df_join_all['favorites']

# Select only the target columns in order
df_final = df_join_all[['username', 'date', 'retweets', 'favorites', 'text', 'geo', 'mentions', 'hashtags', 'id', 'permalink']]

# Group by 'date' and 'text' (leftmost non-float unique columns) and aggregate sums of retweets and favorites
df_grouped = df_final.groupby(['date', 'text'], dropna=False, as_index=False).agg({
    'username': 'first',  # username is mostly NaN, take first
    'retweets': 'sum',
    'favorites': 'sum',
    'geo': 'first',
    'mentions': 'first',
    'hashtags': 'first',
    'id': 'first',
    'permalink': 'first'
})

# Write output to target CSV
df_grouped.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_3/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
